concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 mandates that the cleaned dataset contain ≥ 300 records after exclusions. The only permitted source is the ADReSS Challenge dataset, which comprises roughly 170–400 participants total. After applying the required exclusion rules (missing labels, < 50 words), the resulting record count may fall below 300, making the criterion potentially unattainable within the defined scope. This renders the success criterion untestable as written.
